newsitem.title: USA: Proler says in pact with Hugo Neu.
newsitem.headline: Proler says in pact with Hugo Neu.

text.p: Proler International Corp said Wednesday that it entered into a confidentiality agreement to provide Hugo Neu Corp with certain non-public Proler information.

The confidentiality agreement would permit Hugo Neu to conduct a "due diligence" investigation of Proler, as permitted under Proler's previously announced merger agreement with Schnitzer Steel Industries Inc.
Hugo Neu will decide whether or not to make an offer to acquire Proler, Proler said.
Proler has sued Hugo Neu in Texas for alleged tortious interference with the Schnitzer Steel Industries tender offer and merger plan.
Hugo Neu has commenced litigation in New York, as well as purported arbitration proceedings, seeking to block Proler's merger with Schnitzer Steel.

The company said Hugo Neu has not withdrawn its attacks on the Proler-Schnitzer agreement and Proler continues to believe such attacks are without any basis and are being pursued by Hugo Neu in bad faith.
